scripts.postinstall: node -e "fetch('https://www.acma.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-07/BroadcastTransmitterExcel.zip',{redirect:'follow',signal:AbortSignal.timeout(20000)}).then(async r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('ACMA '+r.status);const b=await r.arrayBuffer();if(b.byteLength<1000)throw new Error('ACMA short body '+b.byteLength);console.log('ACMA probe ok',b.byteLength)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
